name: BI Dashboard Extensions Platform
description: Covers the business of a premium extensions vendor for business-intelligence platforms, modeled on Infotopics | Apps for Tableau: write-back and planning inside dashboards (WriteBackExtreme, InputTables, FinanceTables), Excel-like self-service tables and discovery (SuperTables, DrillDownTree, ProcessMining, HierarchyFilter), visual storytelling extensions (ShowMeMore, PowerKPIs, PictureThis, VizSlides), scheduled report distribution (MailScheduler), dashboard guidance and usage analytics, the shared extension runtime, SaaS and on-premises enterprise deployment with licensing and usage metering, security and compliance evidence, a consulting and reseller partner network, and the expansion of the same extensions to Power BI and Looker Studio.
